entries.effect: Brightly light 3 connected squares within 3 until its next turn.
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Guide the Light

*A ribbon of lanternlight runs along the path, picking out each stone on the way to shelter.*

Brightly light up to 3 connected squares within 3 squares until the start of this creature's next turn. Requires an unobstructed path from this creature to each square; it may choose unlit squares. Ordinary darkness imposes no Boons or Banes for seeing those squares; cover, concealment and hiding still use the normal rules. This neither reveals Hidden creatures automatically nor penetrates opaque obstacles. Reusing this ability replaces its previous illuminated area.

entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Flicker Aside

*Its outline gutters like a flame in a draft and catches again just beyond the reaching hand.*

After an attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, teleport to a visible empty square within 1 square. This creature must survive and remain capable. The destination must support its footprint and be reachable by an unobstructed straight path; this does not pass through walls or occupied squares. No opportunity attacks from this teleport. No trigger from a free attack; no attack is granted.

details.flavorMarkdown: *A small lantern-shaped spirit with legs of light and a steady, smokeless glow. It remembers a particular route with great fidelity, but knows little beyond it.*

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Lifeless Body:** does not breathe or eat; only the listed immunities apply.

**Healing:** Spirit: magical healing works; cannot swallow potions.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** A light moves where an old road vanished beneath the grass.

**Purpose:** Guide a traveler safely along one remembered route.

**Tactics and retreat:** Keep distance and flash at whatever blocks the path.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Ask which road it knows; it does not know every destination.

**Habitat:** Old road; ruin · **Communication:** Understands Common; answers by pointing light while active

**Loot:** Directions, not manufactured lantern oil.

**Summoning:** Spirit 1 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/summons/lantern-spirit.md).
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-lantern-spirit


**Category:** Spirit · **Role:** Guide · **CV:** 6

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Its minor attack is easier to defend, granting a Boon.

**Reference damage:** 1/2/3

**Reference type:** radiant

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.25

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.1 → 1.25: Maneuver allowance +0.05, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.404, O=1.702. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [Flicker Aside](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/flicker-aside.md), [Guide the Light](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/guide-the-light.md), [lifeless body](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/lifeless-body.md).

monsterAbilityTemplates.rulesMarkdown:
The card must list its exact condition immunities; this trait grants no additional unlisted ones. It does not breathe or need food. Undead entries marked healing-harmed take a healing result as Life damage; constructs marked repair-only do not regain HP from ordinary healing. Neither rule prevents physical attacks from dealing their normal minimum damage.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
